friction_events.description: Two compatible atomic CREATE attempts returned the canonical CREATE_EXISTS signature.
After the two collisions, every remaining retained candidate required a definitively absent representative JavaScript browser capability.
The public /wc/exit/ page was not readable through the web reader; the exact durable exit-audit contract was fetched from the repository instead.

decision_trace.decision: Create a fresh v3.30 beacon before allocation.
decision_trace.observable_basis: The launch envelope and fresh-launch policy require a de-novo worker identity as the first durable worker write.
decision_trace.action: Atomically created the beacon and froze worker_id + launch_nonce.

decision_trace.decision: Attempt the deterministic batch shard candidate portfolio-10wc-pre-run-b054.
decision_trace.observable_basis: Beacon commit prefix f4dc004e selected index 0 over the retained compatible candidate view.
decision_trace.outcome: CREATE_EXISTS using the canonical GitHub missing-sha signature.

decision_trace.decision: Advance to the retained GUIDE_INTEGRATOR candidate without rereading the frontier.
decision_trace.observable_basis: The first authority CREATE collided and the integrator candidate required no unavailable capability.
decision_trace.outcome: CREATE_EXISTS using the canonical GitHub missing-sha signature.

decision_trace.decision: Stop allocation instead of claiming browser-only recovery candidates.
decision_trace.observable_basis: All three remaining candidates required representative_javascript_browser, definitively absent from the exposed runtime.
decision_trace.action: Persisted bounded no-allocation evidence with no authority created.
decision_trace.outcome: Compatible frontier exhausted truthfully at E2.

top_time_sinks.note: No remaining compatible unowned candidate after capability filtering.

unfinished_debt.item: This worker produced no product unit because no compatible authority claim was available in its retained frontier.

improvement_candidates.proposal: When a finite batch still expects additional fresh workers, keep at least one extra non-browser compatible candidate in the compact frontier when current compatible claim paths are already occupied, if grounded work exists.
improvement_candidates.expected_effect: Reduce zero-product launches caused by a small compatible frontier without weakening atomic ownership or capability gates.

exit_audit_v1.public_safe_summary: Fresh v3.30 batch worker created its own beacon, encountered two real claim collisions, skipped three browser-only candidates because the required JS-browser capability was absent, and closed at E2 with durable compatible-frontier exhaustion evidence. No authority or product mutation was fabricated.
